title: Communicating Credit Risk with Large Language Models: Evaluation of Explanations from Standard and Alternative Data-Based Models

evidence.sentence: Using Freddie Mac single-family loan-level data, we develop three pipelines: standard tabular (XGBoost + SHAP), and two models with alternative data, a pure network-based model (GNN + GNNExplainer), and a bimodal model (combining tabular and network data).
